"""The demand bar is the quality column and can never end up easier than the archive bar.

_clamp_guardrails bounds min_score_to_surface_demand into
[min_score_to_archive, min_score_to_archive + max_demand_floor_premium]. Both ends have to be
measured against the EFFECTIVE archive floor the operator is running, not against the floor the code
shipped with. An operator who raises min_score_to_archive to 75 and leaves the demand bar alone must
get a demand bar of at least 75. A demand bar that stays at 60 inverts the two lanes in silence:
every demand card the supply lane rejects still clears its own, now easier, floor, which is the
opposite of the invariant this rail exists to hold.
"""
import json

import lib


def _load(tmp_path, cfg):
    p = tmp_path / "watchlist.json"
    p.write_text(json.dumps(cfg), encoding="utf-8")
    return lib.load_config(explicit_path=str(p))["scoring"]


def test_a_tightened_archive_floor_lifts_the_demand_bar_with_it(tmp_path):
    sc = _load(tmp_path, {"scoring": {"min_score_to_archive": 75}})
    assert float(sc["min_score_to_archive"]) == 75.0
    assert float(sc["min_score_to_surface_demand"]) >= 75.0, (
        "demand bar %r sits below the archive floor %r; the quality column became the easier bar"
        % (sc["min_score_to_surface_demand"], sc["min_score_to_archive"]))
    assert float(sc["demand_floor_premium"]) >= 0.0


def test_the_bar_is_still_bounded_above_by_the_premium_cap(tmp_path):
    sc = _load(tmp_path, {"scoring": {"min_score_to_archive": 75,
                                      "min_score_to_surface_demand": 99}})
    arch = float(sc["min_score_to_archive"])
    cap = float(sc["max_demand_floor_premium"])
    assert arch == 75.0
    assert arch <= float(sc["min_score_to_surface_demand"]) <= arch + cap


def test_the_shipped_relationship_is_untouched(tmp_path):
    """Over rejection control: the default config must come out exactly as it always did."""
    sc = _load(tmp_path, {})
    assert float(sc["min_score_to_archive"]) == 55.0
    assert float(sc["min_score_to_surface_demand"]) == 60.0
